title: France says Iran behind 'unprecedented' cyberattacks on fridges

blocks.text: PARIS, France — France on Monday said Iran’s Revolutionary Guards were behind cyberattacks on supermarket refrigerators in the country last month, vowing to impose European-level sanctions on Tehran over what it described as the first large-scale cyber sabotage on French territory. Numerous French supermarkets were hit by cyberattacks on Oct. 11 and 12, which raised the temperatures in their refrigerators. In some cases, stores were forced to throw away entire inventories of perishable food. “I can confirm that this attack was carried out by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of the Islamic Republic of Iran,” Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said […]...
